snippet.title: Spin Rhythm XD Update 11 - 3 New Tracks + Longer Levels Update
snippet.description:
Update 11, 3 new tracks, 40 new backgrounds, complete scoring and level design overhaul and so much more. 

Music - Body F10ating in the Zero Gravity Space | かめりあ(Camellia) - support Camellia at https://cametek.bandcamp.com/album/tera-i-o

Get Spin Rhythm XD on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1058830/Spin_Rhythm_XD/
